jobs.description:
Testing strategy & methodology
•       Own the conversation testing strategy for VinDynamics' humanoid robots across English and Vietnamese, including multi-turn dialogues, code-switching, and domain-specific scenarios (home, assistance, concierge, safety-critical interactions).
•       Define and continuously evolve the test case taxonomy: happy path, edge cases, adversarial inputs, ambiguity, interruptions, repairs, long-horizon context, and emotional/social interactions.
•       Establish release criteria, go/no-go gates, and quality bars for every conversational AI update shipped to robot fleet.
End-to-end log tracing & root cause analysis
•       Chase failing conversations end-to-end across the full voice pipeline: audio capture → ASR → NLU / intent → LLM / agent (including tool calls, RAG, memory) → TTS → robot action.
•       Build and maintain tracing infrastructure (OpenTelemetry, LangSmith/Langfuse, custom span schemas) so every user turn can be reconstructed with inputs, intermediate states, latencies, and outputs.
•       Localize defects to the correct component (ASR mis-recognition vs. LLM hallucination vs. TTS prosody vs. tool-call failure) and drive fixes with the owning team.
Automation framework for conversation testing
•       Design and build an automation framework that runs large-scale conversation tests against both the cloud stack and on-device robot builds — programmatic text-in, synthesized or recorded speech-in, and live microphone runs.
•       Integrate automated conversation tests into CI/CD so every model, prompt, or pipeline change is gated on regression suites before deployment.
•       Scale test execution to thousands of scenarios across languages, accents, and acoustic conditions; build dashboards that make regressions obvious at a glance.
Evaluation metrics & benchmarks for LLMs and agents
•       Define the metric stack for conversational quality: task success, turn-level correctness, groundedness/faithfulness, refusal correctness, safety, hallucination rate, latency budgets, ASR WER/CER, and TTS naturalness.
•       Build internal benchmarks for English and Vietnamese conversations that reflect real VinDynamics use cases, and maintain golden datasets that evolve with the product.
•       Design LLM-as-a-judge evaluation pipelines with calibration against human raters; run structured human evaluation when automated judges are insufficient.
•       Publish weekly/release quality reports with trend analysis, regression attribution, and clear recommendations for model retraining, prompt refinement, or rollback.
Leadership & cross-functional impact
•       Set the hiring bar, mentor, and grow the conversation QA team (QC AI Engineers, Robot Interaction Testers); define the career ladder for conversation testing at VinDynamics.
•       Partner with AI research, NLP/Speech, agentic AI, robotics integration, and product deployment teams to shape models and products from the quality side.
•       Represent conversation quality in executive release reviews; translate technical failure modes into business-level risk.

Wake Word / Keyword Spotting (KWS):

Optimize false rejection rate (FRR) at fixed false alarms per hour (FA/hour) under challenging acoustic conditions, including public spaces, events, and mobile robot environments. Minimize false triggers caused by the robot's own speech through acoustic echo cancellation (AEC).

Collaborate closely with the Agentic AI team on agentic AI, on-device offline TTS, and conversational AI to ensure seamless integration between the speech stack and robot behavior.

Use Case Discovery & Requirements
